title: Slushie Bar Salts Blackberry Lemonade 10ml E-Liquid
description: Blackberry Lemonade from Slushie Bar Salts offers a tantalizing blend that combines the deep, sweet flavours of ripe Blackberries with the crisp, tangy zest of Lemonade. This Nic Salt e-liquid creates an invigorating and enjoyable vaping experience that's both fruity and refreshing. Upon inhaling, you're greeted with the lush, rich taste of Blackberries, bursting with natural sweetness and a hint of tartness. This is seamlessly complemented by the lively, zesty flavour of Lemonade, adding a refreshing twist to the e-liquid. The Lemonade accentuates the Blackberries' depth, resulting in a perfectly balanced blend that's both satisfying and thirst-quenching. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
